summary: Part 2 of 4 (07:12 to 10:25) of the 2.1 Fulfillment App (KAM) video. The trainer tours the Revibe - Fulfillment App (AppSheet, browser): the SKUs available table, then Shipments (Request Status groups, the Add button, the filter icon), then Request products (All, Open and Closed groups, with Cancelled rows), then one shipment's detail panel (related request products, tracking fields, inventory movements, quantity fields, unboxing video, Under QC and Completed times), then one request product's detail panel. The rule that a score is never negative for fulfillment is narration only (no score column on screen) and is medium confidence. The Add form and the filter panel claims from the original pack were not visible in the cited frames and were withdrawn. Frames: 25 distinct frames of the 40 listed were opened and checked against their content; on re-read, some frame file names did not match the image content, so claims were checked against what the images show.

unclear.issue: 'can beat it by putting one dirham less' has no visible comparison on screen. It is not clear what price is being beaten, or whether it relates to the Buybox supplier column.
The sentence 'the price {be?} including a score' is cut off, and no score column is on the SKUs available page. The score rule is stated, but what a score is and where it appears is not explained.
Negative values appear in the Buybox supplier column (-15 on 100 Miles Warehouse received rows, t00528). The trainer does not connect them to the score rule, so no link is stated.

'requested {cancelled?}' is low-confidence. Cancelled rows do appear inside the Open list (Almas Al Burteqali, t00541), but the trainer calls cancelled another stage, so whether cancelled items belong to Open is not clear.
The sentence ends 'or maybe sold for' with the object missing. The visible inventory movement types are only Return to supplier and Bulk QC rejection, so 'sold' is not confirmed.
'it's most probably faisan who did the quality check' is a guess. The screen shows only the Updated by field (faizan.shaikh@revibe.me); it does not show who did the QC.
The trainer says Under QC time is also on the request product, but the request product detail fields shown in t00612 and t00618 do not include Under QC time.
Cables balance and Cables received are shown (both 0) but never explained.
Naif to drop price is a sidebar item that is not explained in this part.
